quests.question: 2 and 4
quests.hint: Say the numbers in order: 2, then ..., then 4.
quests.explanation: 3 sits exactly between 2 and 4 -- one step up from 2 and one step down from 4!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 3 comes just before 4!

quests.hint: Start at 3 and step one number backward.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 3 is 2 -- one less than 3!
quests.funFact: Double 2 is 4! Because 2 + 2 = 4.

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Ten
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Ten" is how we say the number 10 in English, so 10 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 10, it stays exactly the same: 10!

quests.hint: Count up from 6: "6, ...?"
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 6 is 7 -- one more than 6!
quests.funFact: If you had 7 apples and found one more, you would have 8 apples!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 10 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 10 is written in words as "Ten" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: You have exactly 10 fingers and 10 toes all together!

quests.question: 9 or 3
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 9 is greater than 3 -- when counting up, 9 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 9 by 10, it becomes 90!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Nine

quests.explanation: "Nine" is how we say the number 9 in English, so 9 is the digit that matches!

quests.question: 3 or 6
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 6 is greater than 3 -- when counting up, 6 comes later!
quests.funFact: The number 6 is an even number!

quests.hint: Tap every picture once, counting "one, two, three..." as you go.
quests.explanation: Counting one by one gives 10 dice in total -- 10 is the matching number!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 10 comes right after 9!

quests.question: 4 and 6

quests.explanation: 5 sits exactly between 4 and 6 -- one step up from 4 and one step down from 6!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 5 comes right after 4!

quests.hint: The number right before is always one less than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 3 is 2 -- one less than 3!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 2 comes just before 3!

quests.hint: Tap every picture once, counting "one, two, three..." as you go.
quests.explanation: Counting one by one gives 9 cookies in total -- 9 is the matching number!

quests.hint: Point to each fish one at a time and count out loud.
quests.explanation: Counting one by one gives 4 fish in total -- 4 is the matching number!
quests.funFact: If you had 4 apples and found one more, you would have 5 apples!

quests.explanation: 8 is greater than 3 -- when counting up, 8 comes later!
